notes: Source: the managing company (מנורה מבטחים פנסיה וגמל בע"מ) own periodic/interim report, published on the company website CDN (cdn.menoramivt.co.il); the company reports to the Capital Market Authority (not to MAYA); the website report-list pages sit behind a bot-challenge page and were not used. The parent (מנורה מבטחים החזקות) report was not needed.

Fund tables ("ריכוז תוצאות הפעילות", directors report): columns are the report's own fund types. Mapping: מקיפה and כללית = segment pension_new (קרנות פנסיה חדשות); קופות גמל לחסכון ואישיות לפיצויים, אחר (קופות מרכזיות לפיצויים, קופה משתתפת בפנסיה תקציבית, קופה למטרה אחרת), קרנות השתלמות, מסלולי קופות גמל מבטיחי תשואה, קופת גמל להשקעה, קופת גמל להשקעה לחיסכון ארוך טווח לילד = segment provident, each with its own sub_segment; סך הכל = segment total (all funds). No provident-only or pension-only subtotal is printed, nothing was summed. No veteran pension funds appear in this report (pension_veteran not printed).

Balance items (members, aum) are instant at the table date; flows, fees and fee rates take the table window. Interim reports print the year-to-date table only (no separate three-month fund table); Q1 year-to-date = three months, recorded as window q.

members: מספר עמיתים/חשבונות; active = a member with a deposit in one of the three months before the report date and a balance above zero (footnote 3); in the pension funds counts members with balance above NIS 10 (footnote 2). aum: נכסים מנוהלים, נטו (NIS thousands); the active and inactive rows exclude the reserves for existing entitled/recipients/pensioners and IBNR (footnote 4); the entitled / recipients / pensioners rows are the separate pension-reserve rows printed under the same heading (variant field). No total AUM row is printed in the table.

transfers_in / transfers_out are printed net of transfers between the guaranteed-yield tracks and the provident funds (footnote), recorded separately as transfers_between_tracks with the footnote amount. Management fees from pensioners: rows "מקבלי קצבה" (variant pension_recipients). Fees of the pension funds for members up to age 21 are paid by Bituach Leumi (footnote 7).

Extra fact fields beyond the spec (same convention as the other menora files): component = the fund type or segment column as printed; population = active / inactive / recipients / total where a row splits by it. Nothing is summed. Units: NIS thousand unless the fact says otherwise (members: count; fee rates: percent).
